scope: O04 Chat Collector owner capture and policy inventory; attribution is recorded and unverified, consent is not inferred.

selection.appId: authenticates the leased operation; never filters chat rows

selector.accountOwnerOnly: include candidate and fail capture as CHAT_EXPORT_AMBIGUOUS_ACCOUNT_OWNER
selector.messageSelector: senderId only; recipients never select messages

selection.provenance: Current profile matching is selection evidence only; historical attribution and consent are unverified. This receipt does not assert exclusive ownership, current authority, or visibility.

subject.rule: Select if any captured profile occurs in participants, equals ownerId, or authored any message. Also select account-UUID owner-only candidates so capture fails closed as ambiguous when none of those profile proofs exists.
subject.legacyProvenance: Recorded attribution only; current matching does not prove historical attribution, consent, exclusive ownership, or authority.

columns.handling: Allowlisted enum, actual boolean, and exact microsecond timestamp projection.
columns.reason: Minimal context receipt for recorded shared conversation involvement.

columns.handling: Never selected or emitted; SQL derives only boolean participation, stewardship, and sent-message indicators.
columns.reason: Conversation labels, owner identity, and full participant lists expose other people or unrelated context.

relations.handling: Exists checks only for recorded sent-message evidence; selected message records are exported separately for captured sender profiles.
relations.reason: Preserve historical sent-contribution context without traversing unrelated messages.

subject.rule: Select only where senderId matches a captured profile; recipients never select a message. Export all historical states for the sender without membership or visibility filters. Require parent conversation existence or fail the complete capture.
subject.legacyProvenance: Sender attribution is recorded and unverified; recipient identity is not collected.

columns.handling: Strict UUID projection; senderId is the canonical captured profile UUID and conversationId remains opaque.
columns.reason: Identify the person's recorded sent contribution and its parent context.

columns.handling: Allowlisted enum and exact microsecond timestamps.
Read only for type chat as inert text, capped at 65536 Unicode characters; generated or unverified types omit content and carry an exclusion disposition.
columns.reason: Bounded authored text without interpreting generated notices as authored content.

columns.handling: Never selected or emitted and never used for selection.
columns.reason: Recipient arrays expose other people and do not establish authorship.

relations.handling: Require the parent conversation by generated conversationId foreign key; export only its opaque UUID and fail the complete capture if missing.
relations.reason: Avoid silently dropping orphaned authored records; ORM declares ON DELETE CASCADE and this owner implements no deletion.

stores.name: typeorm_migrations_store
stores.handling: Schema bookkeeping is outside owner capture.
stores.reason: Migration metadata is not a chat account record.

stores.name: processOutput
stores.handling: Operational output may contain message or profile identifiers; retention remains unresolved under N04.
stores.reason: Logs and process output are not captured account records.

stores.name: configurationInputs
stores.handling: Configuration inputs and credentials are opaque and never exported.
stores.reason: Operational secrets and deployment settings are outside account export.

stores.name: Gateway.connectedClients
stores.handling: Volatile shared socket registry is excluded separately under N02; no Redis persistence is claimed.
stores.reason: Transient connection state is not an owner database store.
